_comment: Lal Kitab varshphal (annual chart) house-movement table. 'table' maps the natal house (1-12) to a list of 35 annual houses for cycle years 1..35 (year of life = completed age + 1; ages beyond 35 wrap). Fill from the original Lal Kitab varshphal chakra; until then only one column is verified from a published worked example (46th year = cycle year 11, futuresamachar.com/hi/lal-kitab-varshphal-7166) and the engine uses the simple rotation fallback marked 'rotation'. review_status: unverified.
